thread:
chloe: Hey, trying the node quickstart (master branch) — local app prints 'first call ok' but the streamed response aborts and the console shows no tokens in dashboard.
maya: can you paste the exact error you see? and what type of key are you using? personal/org/service-account?
chloe: here's the error from the server:
```
{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"Workspace needs billing activation to use streaming endpoints"}}
```
chloe: I'm using my user API key from profile, new workspace we created yesterday
sam: ah yep, new orgs need billing toggle for streaming + reserved endpoints. we should've surfaced that in quickstart. cc @alex
alex: filed DX issue #1203 to add a check and clearer message in the starter. workaround: ask an org owner to enable billing or create a service account (owners only). also you can use Playground for testing until it's on.
maya: hmm quickstart should detect that and show an actionable link like 'Enable billing' instead of opaque 4xx. will add a patch.
chloe: owner is OOO until monday — any shorter workaround that doesn't require owner?
sam: short term: spin up a personal workspace and use that key, or use hosted demo model via playground with your user key. both avoid the org billing gate.
chloe: ok trying playground — thanks. feel free to ping me to test the quickstart patch
alex: noted, will DM you when the PR is up. adding a small log change to check billing state before the first stream call :+1:
deploy-bot: New issue created: devex/quickstarts#1203 'quickstart: surface billing state for streaming calls' by alex
chloe: Thanks all :pray:
